newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse closed for Christmas until Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse closed for Christmas until Friday.

text.p: 0800 GMT - The Brussels bourse remains closed for the Christmas break until Friday.
* The Bel-20 share index ended Tuesday's half-day session down 0.21 percent at 1,878.38 with a modest 843 million francs worth of Belgian shares changing hands.
* Dealers expect trade to remain quiet until the New Year.
